"points earned" / "points-earned entry" leads to "Crediting Owner Rewards Points for a Paid Repair Order" whose write books "one points-earned entry for the paid repair order".
- Hop P1 <- P2 (state-derived): crediting doc: "The points for a paid repair order are fixed only after the records carry the overage credit owed on every line of it billed beyond its estimate tolerance." RO 262107 A billed 917.72 vs 838.887 allowed; no overage credit row. "overage credit" leads to the desk guide whose write books "an estimate overage credit".
- Hop P0 <- P3 (state-derived): redemption date 2026-10-31 is October's last day; no `points_expired` row with billing_month 2026-10; "Month-End Expiry of Owner Rewards Points" books "one points-expired entry for the stated month".
- Order: P2 -> P1 -> P0; P3 -> P0 (P3 independent of P1/P2). No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, route or chain.

### Counter-proofs
- "Only redeem": excluded by the two prerequisite sentences + records (RO 262107 points missing, October run not made); the redemption figure would also differ (balance 27153 vs 28541).
- Nearest alternatives: single latest authorization (186.54) excluded by the supplemental-authorization factor; 10% tolerance excluded by the Gold age factor; whole balance excluded by the held-points factor; 0.01 point value excluded by long-member factor; open RO = latest labor charge (RO 262245), not RO 262107.
- Factor findability: account age (opened_date), Kessler Care plan / Kessler Shield contract / purchase deal records (named by product in each factor doc), payments/returned payment/redemption rows, store on labor charge vs home store, shop fee rows, authorization rows. No computation doc hints at a variation (assembly sentences say "every ... this policy sets out" — noted for step 3b).
- Residual reading notes: diagnostic fee rows treated as not "labor and parts charges"; the returned 2026-03-17 payment counted as "received" (immaterial: thresholds met either way).
